mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at 0.19% is historically low, compressing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate prolonged monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.5%, it signals a weak labor market, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market weakness (PAYEMS growth < 0%) and monetary policy remains loose (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%), it predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to heightened recession risk and reduced equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS growth < 0% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% occurs in more than 45% of instances with positive 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13200 billion) signals robust economic activity, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates and market sentiment improves on sustained expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 13200.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, it indicates accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as market volatility increases.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.

mechanism_narrative: The current housing starts (HOUST) at 598.0 units is below the 600 threshold, indicating weak housing demand and predicting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors seek safe havens during economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 600.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts are weak (HOUST < 600) and industrial production is contracting (INDPRO < 93), it predicts negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to concurrent demand and supply shocks reducing corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST < 600 and INDPRO < 93 occurs in more than 45% of instances with positive 60-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 95) signals robust manufacturing activity, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as market sentiment improves on economic strength and reduced recession fears.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 95.
